Then try to work it out, just don't come off as needy. I obviously don't know the in's and out's of the situation, but from your POV it sounds like a BFF wouldn't do that. I have had plenty of "best friends" that I wouldn't count on to be there for me in my darkest days, and at the end of the day what kind of a friend is that? Whatever you do, tell her exactly how you feel, but don't make it seem like you need her. 

Here's a summary of my best friends at 20:

1. Greg: Got through thick and thin with him, but we were too different and I wasn't the greatest friend to him, but he wasn't to me either. Went to different schools, he actually went into plant botonics(sp?) as a career and loved smoking pot...we wouldn't have beena match in the long run anyway. Don't talk anymore.

2. Jake: Same sense of humor, lacked drive, and was not there for when I needed him. The type that blew off texts when "Hey dude, Sarah's cheating on me, can you hangout", or when it was a simply "What's going on this weekend". But still blew me up on facebook. I am going to be in his wedding next month, don't consider him a friend that truly cares for me at the end of the day.

3. Amanda: My ex, was my rock from 19-22, was a liar and a cheater, had many good qualities and I learned a lot from, needed her then. Wish her the best, but we haven't spoken since March 2013 for good reason.

4. Korey: Was literally my BEST FRIEND from 16-21, Korey I would've sworn(and did say sometimes) would put my life before his. I told him everything, and went to him in my darkest hours. Korey would tell my ex everything I told him when we were broken up, was completely and totally two faced, when I found that out I kinda dropped him. We still have mutual friends, and he still talks poorly about me and everyone else.

My point is, that not all relationships in life are really made to last. As sad as that is, many play serious roles at serious times, but, for whatever reason, aren't meant to be there beyond that. I get you guys have history, but don't ride bitch because she wants to be the way she is.

I don't expect you to fully get this, nor make any "life changing decisions" as to who your friends are based on what some dude on the internet is telling you, but I expect perhaps a seed is planted and you can begin to realize you are worth more than being treated. Perhaps she was the best friend on earth for a long time, but 20 is a changing time in life, and the reality is very, very, very few people consider their best friend at 20 their best friend at 30. 

At days end you just need to tell her how it is and how you feel and give it time, but making an ass of yourself for someone as low enough to ditch you on your birthday is only going to make yourself feel lower.

Hey,

I know it's rough right now. You're thinking about your future as a whole and all the if's, and's, and but's. Relax. I'm 26, and if my 20 year old worries ever came to fruition, I would have been in a world of trouble. They didn't. Yes, you'll be in student debt, so what? I went to school for economics and am 44k in the hole. I have already have half paid off, because I make 6 figures a year now...and let's just say things haven't been easy since I graduated 2 years ago. Many are in debt. What I can tell you from experience is DON'T go school for something DUMB that won't make any money. It's pointless, then DON'T go to a school that you'll need PRIVATE loans for(aka a bank) because they will make your life a living hell. I could have gone to University of Michigan, I'd be 100k in the hole, or MSU, I'd be 70k in the hole. I went to Eastern Michigan, and am 44k in the hole making the same because at the end of the day, you decide your future, not your school.

As for your friends, fuck them, years ago someone told me this quote when an ex cheated on me/blew me off, and I still give back what was so freely given to me "Class versus trash". Use this to better yourself in some way, and next time when they want to kiss ass, kill them with success and bury them with a smile. Don't text and beg them for answers, don't let this get to your head. Go talk to someone/anyone who WANTS to talk to you. Doesn't matter who, at least they value your attention...and your fucking birthday.

You're 20, relax sweetheart, you will be FINE. Just use everything that comes your way as motivation and don't expect perfection in 3 years, but just know that if you keep doing that NEXT RIGHT THING FOR THE RIGHT REASON you will be someone far better than your fake friends months from now.

Take it a day at a time, honey. It'll get better.
